vtubestudio.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to VTube Studio and allowed in as a plugin.
vtubestudio.isConnected.returns: true while connected and allowed, otherwise false.

vtubestudio.triggerHotkey.description: Runs one of your VTube Studio hotkeys, like a wave or an outfit change. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.

parameters.hotkey: The hotkey's name as VTube Studio shows it, like "Wave", or its id.
parameters.itemInstanceId: Optional. The id of a Live2D item, to press that item's hotkey instead of the model's. Most people leave it out.

vtubestudio.triggerHotkey.returns: The id of the hotkey that ran.

vtubestudio.loadModel.description: Switches VTube Studio to another model. Fails with an error when no model has that name or VTube Studio is not connected.

parameters.model: The model's name as VTube Studio shows it, like "Akari", or its id.

vtubestudio.loadModel.returns: The id of the model that was loaded.

vtubestudio.moveModel.description: Moves, turns or resizes your model on screen. Values you leave out stay as they are. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.

parameters.time: Optional. How long the move takes, 0 to 2 seconds. Default 0.5.
parameters.relative: Optional. true moves the model by these amounts from where it is now. false (default) moves it to these exact values.
parameters.positionX: Optional. Left/right position: -1 is the left edge, 1 is the right edge.
parameters.positionY: Optional. Up/down position: -1 is the bottom edge, 1 is the top edge.
parameters.rotation: Optional. How far to turn the model, in degrees, like 15.
parameters.size: Optional. The model's size, from -100 (small) to 100 (big).

vtubestudio.setExpression.description: Turns a face expression on your model on or off, like blush or angry eyes. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.

parameters.expression: The expression's name or file, like "Blush" or "Blush.exp3.json".
parameters.fadeTime: Optional. How many seconds the change takes to fade in or out. Leave it out for 0.25 seconds.

vtubestudio.setExpression.returns: The new state: true for on, false for off.

vtubestudio.injectParameters.description: Sets tracking values on your model for a while, like tilting the head or opening the mouth. Your script waits until the time is over.

parameters.parameters: The values as text, like "FaceAngleX=20, MouthOpen=1". You can also give an object, like {"FaceAngleX": 20}.
parameters.holdSeconds: Optional. How many seconds to keep the values, 0 to 3600. Default 1.
parameters.mode: Optional. "add" adds the values to the tracking. Anything else (the default) replaces the tracking values.
parameters.faceFound: Optional. true tells VTube Studio to act as if it sees your face while the values are sent. Starts as false.

vtubestudio.getCurrentModel.description: Tells you which model VTube Studio has loaded and where it is on screen. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.
vtubestudio.getCurrentModel.returns: loaded (true/false), name, id, positionX, positionY, rotation and size.

vtubestudio.getHotkeys.description: Lists the hotkeys of the model that is loaded now. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.
vtubestudio.getHotkeys.returns: A list of hotkeys. Each has id, name, type (what it does) and file.

vtubestudio.getExpressions.description: Lists the face expressions of the model that is loaded now, and which ones are on. Fails with an error when VTube Studio is not connected.
vtubestudio.getExpressions.returns: A list of expressions. Each has name, file and active (true when it is on).

vtubestudio.request.description: Sends any VTube Studio API request and gives back its answer. For advanced users who know VTube Studio's request names.

parameters.data: Optional. The request's settings as an object, like {"hotkeyID": "Wave"}.

vtubestudio.request.returns: VTube Studio's answer data, or null when it sent none.
